notes.title: Update 1.10 is Out!
notes.notes:
Good Sol to You, Strategists!

This update includes several improvements designed to enhance your gameplay experience:

 Animated Intro: Immerse yourself with the new animated introduction.
 Wave Variability: Encounter more diverse and challenging waves of enemies, keeping every battle fresh.
 Rebalanced Enemies: Enjoy a more balanced combat experience with reworked enemy stats and behaviours.
 Various Fixes: Bug-fixes and minor improvements.

I also wish to inform you that the Journal feature has been postponed to Update 1.20. I apologise for the delay and appreciate your understanding as I continue to refine this key aspect of the game.

These updates improve the overall gameplay experience. Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: [Update 1.00.8] Patch Notes
notes.notes:
New Improvements:

 Bugfix: Resolved the 'Master Strategist' achievement issue.
 Bugfix: Fixed the blinking tooltip in certain situations.
 Progress Reset: Nullified values in stats after resetting progress.
 Game Logic: Enhanced game sequencing logic for smoother gameplay.
 Settings: Fixed jitteriness in the settings scroll.


These updates enhance stability and improve the overall gameplay experience. Thank you for your continued support and feedback!
